text_block_list.text:
"Mejiro Bright devotedly puts her all into 
training in preparation for the Satsuki 
Sho, but—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If I pull away from the very start with 
this pace...! Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Wait... Dober!? Kh... Guhh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Alright, my win! I figured if I took the 
lead with this pacing, I could seal off 
Bright's late charge!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"I should have been able to reach them if 
I chased with all my might. And yet..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer, why...?
choice_data_list:
So the challenge really is 'race-craft' 
after all, huh.

So the challenge really is 'race-craft' 
after all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Race... make?

"Pacemaking." In other words, whether you 
can dictate the flow of the race yourself 
is an extremely crucial factor.

Umamusume who can dictate a race tend to 
be Front Runners or Leaders. By 
controlling the overall pace, they create 
a flow favorable to themselves, but—

Umamusume who rely on a late-race burst 
can't do that, making things tough if the 
race pace doesn't favor them.

Mejiro Dober can dictate the pace of a 
race, while Mejiro Bright was the classic 
type who couldn't.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Um, should I run like Dober does too, 
then~?
choice_data_list: No, it won't be that easy.
No, it's not going to be that simple.

text_block_list.text:
"In the first place, running styles are 
largely innate, and if you try to change 
them haphazardly, you'll end up erasing 
their individuality—their greatest 
weapon."

We have to find a way for Mejiro Bright to 
grow stronger while remaining true to who 
she is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho that Bright is running in 
is at Nakayama, right? The final stretch 
is pretty short, so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It might be dangerous if things stay as 
they are. Especially if the pace doesn't 
suit Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we should think of a countermeasure. 
I can't think of anything specific, 
though...
choice_data_list:
Alright, let's invite an Uma Musume who's 
skilled at making her move to coach us

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer? A coach... you say?

Even among Umamusume who rely on late-race 
bursts, there are those who know how to 
make their move. Those who can judge the 
optimal moment to spurt even in an 
unfavorable pace.

When I explained to Mejiro Bright that 
learning from an Umamusume with such 
skills would help conquer Nakayama...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Even at a disadvantage... I can read it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer-sama? If at all possible, you 
see...~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Rather than someone who finds it easy, I 
would love to be taught by someone who 
struggled yet found a way to confront it 
anyway~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Even if someone dexterous teaches me, it 
won't make me dexterous. So, I'd rather 
learn from someone who understands the 
struggle...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The same suffering... I see. That might be 
one way to look at it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hearing stories from umamusume of the same 
type as Bright would definitely be more 
helpful.

The wish Mejiro Bright casually brought up 
actually made quite a lot of sense.

“—Speaking of Umamusume with great 
late-race burst and talent who struggled 
during the Classics...”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for inviting me, Trainer! If 
it's to coach Bright, I'd be more than 
happy to!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Alright Bright, I'm gonna be strict with 
you! Let's... Muscle-!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I look forward to working with you~. 
Ryan-oneesama...♪

Having welcomed Mejiro Ryan, whom she 
looks up to more than anyone, as her 
coach, Mejiro Bright's eyes are sparkling 
with life.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Listen, Bright. A short straightaway isn't 
just a matter of distance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Because of that, you have to be careful 
with your positioning, or your 
acceleration will lag, and you won't make 
it in time unless you boldly pierce 
through the inside."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'll gather some Umamusume I know, so 
let's start with a mock race!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes, Ryan-onesama...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You're taking the turn way too wide, 
Bright! If you're going to hold off on 
your move that long, find an opening on 
the inside and cut through!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, this is ve~ry difficult, isn't 
it~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Right, if you don't do this right, you'll 
repeat my mistakes. I don't want you to 
end up peaking as "just pretty good."
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, Ryan also...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I lost! Well, a big part of it was 
just that I wasn't good enough, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I don't want Bright to go through that 
kind of pain. So let's do our best, 
Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yeees...!

Mejiro Ryan shared her personal 
experiences while cheerfully talking about 
past defeats. Asking her to coach was 
definitely the right call.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Bright, no Mejiro Umamusume has ever won 
the Satsuki Sho. But――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry about that, let's just run a 
great race! Absolutely! So we don't leave 
any regrets!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes... Dear Sister Ryan!

"Yes, the challenge for the Triple Crown 
is Bright's own battle, but at the same 
time, it is the continuation of the Mejiro 
family's legacy."

The heavy expectations of her family 
rested firmly upon the carefree young 
lady's shoulders. Even so, Mejiro Bright 
looked immensely happy.
